metadata.description: Claude plugins from the AI Growth Systems Bootcamp. Voice Miner: learn your real voice from your sent email and sales calls, without the AI tells. GTM context: build your go-to-market context layer (product, ICP, competitors, customer language, objections, shareable customers) in Notion or in GitHub only. Do not contact: one list of people your outreach must skip, kept in a Google Sheet or Notion and checked before every send.

plugins.name: gtm-context-notion
plugins.description: GTM context that lives in Notion: one GTM Hub page, short context pages and queryable databases for competitors, objections and customers. Ends by creating your own update skill that keeps it current on a schedule.

plugins.name: gtm-context-github
plugins.description: GTM context that lives in your own GitHub repo: a gtm/ folder with short markdown pages and CSV banks for competitors, objections and customers. Ends by creating your own update skill that keeps it current on a schedule.

plugins.name: voice-miner
plugins.description: Learn your real voice from your sent emails and sales calls, filter out anything AI-written, and build a personal skill that writes emails, cold outreach and LinkedIn posts that sound like you.

plugins.name: do-not-contact
plugins.description: One do-not-contact list every outreach system checks first, built from your own description of who must never be contacted: people who said no, unsubscribed or bounced, customers, open deals, testimonial givers, friends, family and partners. Read only from the places you name, kept in a Google Sheet or Notion, updated weekly. If your CRM already holds it all, that stays your list.
